answer: Your last A1c in the records was 6.9% on 16 February 2026. That is the most recent test through 15 October 2026. It has fallen at each check since a peak of 8.3% in January 2025, when you were on no diabetes medicine other than the one prescribed in February 2025. A new A1c is due, since it has been about eight and a half months.
short: Last A1c: 6.9% on 16 Feb 2026, down from a peak of 8.3% in Jan 2025. No A1c since, so one is due.

knowledge.says: For many adults with type 2 diabetes the A1c goal is below 7%, and 6.9% is within that. A check every three to six months is usual, so one is due now.
knowledge.guideline: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes

links.says: The A1c fell from 8.3% in January 2025 to 7.1% in August 2025.
The August 2025 result of 7.1% came before the 6.9% result in February 2026, so the fall continued.
